test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average weight of a group of 20 persons is 40 kg. The average weight of another group of 40 persons is K kg. If the average weight of all the 60 persons is 60 kg, then what is the value of K?
solution:
Given: 

The average weight of 20 persons = 40 kg

The average weight of another group of 40 persons = K kg.

The average weight of 60 persons = 60 kg

Formula:

Average = (Sum of observations) / (Number of observations)

Solution:

⇒ 20 × 40 + 40 × k = 60 × 60

⇒ 800 + 40 × k = 3600

⇒ 40 × k = 2800

k = 70

The answer is 70 kg.
